stops.name: Forest of Sénart
stops.detail: The Forest of Sénart (French: Forêt de Sénart, French pronunciation: [fɔʁɛ də senaʁ]) is located in the French department of Essonne.  It covers 3,000 hectares in area, this forest is very important to the local population. The local government has kept roads and agricultural companies from cutting down parts of this forest. There are roughly 2-3 million visitors a year, and the government spends 1.2 million euros a year maintaining the forest.
